description: Example: ingest a source file from raw/ into the wiki. Disabled by default. Copy to tasks/, edit the prompt to point at a real file you've dropped in raw/, then fire manually with `npm run run-task -- example-ingest`.
prompt:
Read `raw/<your-source-file>` and ingest it into the wiki.

Steps:
1. Read the source file from raw/.
2. Identify the entities, concepts, and any synthesis-worthy ideas it covers.
3. Create or update the appropriate wiki page(s) under `wiki/<page-type>/<kebab-case-name>.md`. Page types: entities, concepts, syntheses, timelines.
4. Update `wiki/index.md` to list any new page with a one-line summary.
5. Append a one-line entry to `wiki/log.md` in the format `## [YYYY-MM-DD] ingest | <Title>`, plus a short summary.

Return a one-paragraph summary as your final response.
